models.qualification: Exact Córdoba marble DJ031626, distinct from the Lely Venus and other crouching Aphrodite copies already catalogued. Primary museum page dates 138–192 CE, records 89 cm height, 40 cm maximum width, Parian marble and documented physical losses. Conservation bulletin independently identifies DJ031626. Strong largest thumbnail shows coherent surviving figure and base. Native crown/reverse/underside preflight required. Production country is unconfirmed; Spain is the findspot, not asserted manufacture.

Specific Strasbourg wild-cherry sculpture, 1938, verified in museum-authored Recto/Verso teaching dossier hosted by Académie de Strasbourg. Current BY listingGLB8MB. Largest thumbnail shows whole reclining adult figure and base with photographic wood grain. Native preflight must inspect head, raised foot, hand/body interstices and reverse. Exact production place is unconfirmed; do not substitute holding-museum country.
